no-restricted-syntax.message: Never extract YMD via .toISOString().slice(0, 10) — it's UTC-based and shifts the day in non-UTC zones. Use localDateToYmd() from @/lib/utils/dates.
new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') parses as UTC midnight and breaks in non-UTC zones. Use parseYmd() or ymdToLocalDate() from @/lib/utils/dates.

Use <Link> from next/link for internal navigation. Raw <a href='/...'> triggers a full page reload (loses React state, refetches the layout, re-runs auth). Only use <a> for external links (http/mailto/tel).
